meta.title: DistilBERT, a distilled version of BERT: smaller, faster, cheaper and lighter

questions.text: How can we create a smaller, faster, and cheaper language model while retaining performance?
questions.goal: To develop DistilBERT, a distilled version of BERT.
questions.source_text: we propose a method to pre-train a smaller general-purpose language representation model, called DistilBERT

questions.text: What is the impact of knowledge distillation on model size and performance?
questions.goal: To evaluate the effectiveness of knowledge distillation in reducing model size while maintaining performance.
questions.source_text: we show that it is possible to reach similar performances on many downstream-tasks using much smaller language models

questions.text: What are the components of the triple loss used in training DistilBERT?
questions.goal: To analyze the contributions of each component of the triple loss.
questions.source_text: we introduce a triple loss combining language modeling, distillation and cosine-distance losses

questions.text: How does DistilBERT perform on various NLP tasks compared to BERT?
questions.goal: To compare the performance of DistilBERT with BERT on downstream tasks.
questions.source_text: DistilBERT is always on par or improving over the ELMo baseline

questions.text: What is the effect of different components of the triple loss on performance?
questions.goal: To conduct an ablation study on the triple loss components.
questions.source_text: we investigate the influence of various components of the triple loss
